title: ‘It’s due to climate’: the people of Stourbridge on the town’s wildfires

paragraphs.en: People in Stourbridge have described the fires that devastated more than a dozen homes as “horrendous” and “distressing”, with one describing blazes that surpassed the height of residential houses.
paragraphs.zh: 斯陶尔布里奇的居民用“骇人”和“令人痛心”来形容烧毁十多所房屋的大火，还有人描述火势曾高过居民住宅楼。

paragraphs.en: Multiple fires spread across the West Midlands on Thursday as temperatures reached record highs of 38.1C in the UK, during the country’s fifth consecutive heatwave.
paragraphs.zh: 周四，在英国的第五次连续热浪中，全国气温达到创纪录的38.1摄氏度，西米德兰兹郡多地同时燃起大火。

paragraphs.en: Fifty-four people, including 19 who were taken to hospital, were treated at eight different fires on Thursday, West Midlands ambulance service said, with the fire service confirming 19 homes in Stourbridge, a market town in Dudley, had been fully destroyed and an additional 18 damaged.
paragraphs.zh: 西米德兰兹郡救护车服务表示，周四在八处不同的大火中，共有54人得到救治，其中19人被送往医院。消防部门证实，位于达德利市场镇的斯陶尔布里奇共有19所房屋被完全烧毁，另有18所受损。

paragraphs.en: During a visit to Stourbridge on Friday, Andy Burnham said the UK was like a “tinderbox” and announced the commission of firefighting planes to tackle future wildfires. “I’ve never seen scenes like this anywhere in Britain,” he told the BBC.
paragraphs.zh: 周五在斯陶尔布里奇视察期间，安迪·伯纳姆表示英国就像个“火药桶”，并宣布订购消防飞机以应对未来的野火。“我在英国任何地方都没见过这样的场面。”他告诉英国广播公司（BBC）。

paragraphs.en: The Guardian spoke to people who were forced to hurriedly evacuate from their homes in Stourbridge on Thursday, as a wildfire spread near the town’s golf course.
paragraphs.zh: 《卫报》采访了周四在斯陶尔布里奇被迫紧急撤离家园的居民，当时一场野火蔓延至该镇高尔夫球场附近。

paragraphs.en: They repeatedly praised the support and efforts of local authorities and neighbours, but are yet to return home, with some staying at a nearby hotel or a makeshift evacuation centre that had been set up at a local boarding school.
paragraphs.zh: 他们一再称赞地方当局和邻居们的支持与努力，但目前仍无法回家，有些人暂住在附近的酒店，或暂住在当地一所寄宿学校设立临时疏散中心里。

paragraphs.en: Gemma Hobbs, 46, and her partner, Andy, 61, were evacuated from their home on Osmaston Road on Thursday, as the wildfires raged over a mile away. Andy described seeing a house in flames.
paragraphs.zh: 周四，46岁的杰玛·霍布斯和61岁的伴侣安迪被从奥斯马斯顿路的家中疏散，当时野火在超过一英里外熊熊燃烧。安迪描述说，他目睹了一所房屋被火焰吞没。

paragraphs.en: Gemma said: “I looked out the windows and all I could see was thick black smoke. My husband came home in a bit of a flap and said: ‘We’ve got to get out. We’ve got to get out immediately.’”
paragraphs.zh: 杰玛说：“我望向窗外，只能看到浓黑的烟雾。我丈夫慌慌张张地回到家，说：‘我们得离开。我们得马上离开。’”
